_waitStopOnAttentionNote: What a blocking `subagent_wait` that did not name the flag itself gets. pi-subagents resolves it as `params.stopOnAttention ?? deps.stopOnAttention !== false` (runs/background/subagent-wait.ts:562), so an omitted parameter means TRUE and the wait ends on ANY needs_attention run. Two of the three producers of that state are heuristics, not questions: idle beyond 60s, scaled x2/x5/x10 for medium/high/xhigh thinking (runs/shared/subagent-control.ts:19, scaledNeedsAttentionAfterMs :82-95, deriveActivityState :97-110), and one tool call open for 240s or more (:21, shouldEmitOpenToolAttention :112-121). Neither means the child is asking the lead anything, and every spurious wake re-reads the lead's whole context at full price. The genuine ask, a pending contact_supervisor/intercom request, is hasSupervisorTool (subagent-wait.ts:248) and is checked INDEPENDENTLY of this flag (`stopOnAttention || hasSupervisorTool(run)`, :566), which is why lowering the default loses nothing; terminal states are a different branch of the same predicate and are untouched. WHY THIS LIVES HERE AND NOT IN config/subagent.json: there is no key for it anywhere in the package. resolveWaitToolConfig returns `{ enabled }` and nothing else (runs/background/wait-config.ts), and subagents.watchdog in config/settings.json is a strict parser that rejects unknown fields. The package's own internal auto-drain is the ONLY injector of the dep and it passes false (runs/background/auto-drain.ts:59): upstream agrees with the value, it just does not expose it. So extensions/dispatch/wait-attention.ts writes it onto the call from the DSP-WAIT tool_call rule, the same in-place argument rewrite clampConcurrency uses, and test/dispatch/watchdog-settings.test.ts still pins the three upstream facts so the day a real key appears, this stops being needed. An explicit `stopOnAttention` on the call always wins, and a `nonBlocking: true` subscription is left alone because the flag cannot reach that branch. Set `waitStopOnAttention: true` to restore the package default; nothing is then written at all.
